priorities.summary: LMCache's multiprocess (distributed) mode opens an unauthenticated ZeroMQ ROUTER socket where msgpack extension code 1 is passed to pickle.loads before any handler validation, letting an unauthenticated remote attacker execute arbitrary code — as root in official container images — with a single ZMQ message. Discovered by JFrog Security Research.

Splunk Enterprise (10.4.x before 10.4.3, 10.2.x before 10.2.7) exposes the Patroni REST API on search head cluster members without authentication for critical configuration operations, allowing any network-reachable attacker to execute attacker-controlled OS commands. Advisory SVD-2026-1001.

LMCache through 0.5.5 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in its /run_script endpoint: remote attackers can post scripts that execute Python code and OS commands as the LMCache process, recovering real builtins through the injected FastAPI app object to bypass the guarded __import__. Disclosed by VulnCheck.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
model.summary: OpenAI began the global rollout of GPT-6 in ChatGPT on Oct 7, adding an Intelligent UI that renders interactive elements — charts, forms, calculators, games — inside responses instead of plain text. Paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol while Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna, with free-tier access starting Oct 8.
